notes: Rule: A.1 item 13 'CALL statement (rules for program-name formation for a non-COBOL program). This item is conditionally required because it is conditioned upon support for calling non-COBOL programs. This item shall be documented... (14.9.4 GR3b)'. cite.py --check 14.9.4.4 "If the program being called is not a COBOL program, the rules for program-name formation and for locating the program are defined by the implementor" -> OK (§14.9.4.4 3b). Calling non-COBOL programs is NOT supported: ProbeSiblingModule loads <name>.dll and requires a __CobolModule.Register() registrar, else 'not a COBOL.NET module' -> false -> EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND. Probe callfor.cob / callfor2.cob: CALL "Antlr4.Runtime.Standard" (a real foreign .NET dll in AppContext.BaseDirectory) and CALL identifier 'System.Runtime' both take ON EXCEPTION with EXCEPTION-STATUS = EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND. So the conditional obligation is NOT incurred, and CONFORMANCE.md §3 does say 'a non-COBOL element cannot be the TARGET of a CALL' (plus DOC-A.1-19 'no non-COBOL program can be declared'). PARTIAL rather than CONFORMS: there is no DOC-A.1-13 disposition row, so the register cannot see that the item is un-incurred (audit_annex_a1.py counts it in the 195), and even with a 'Not provided' row the derived 'a1-optional-not-provided' selector is keyed to requirement 'optional' and would not reach a CONDITIONALLY-REQUIRED item — no path to a closed verdict exists today (see findings: un-incurred-A.1-items-have-no-disposition-path). Umbrella kb/Work A11.
